Press Release: “Emperador Strengthens Sustainability with First Sustainability-Linked Loan

Emperador Inc. (“EMI”), together with Emperador Distillers, Inc. (“EDI”), will guarantee the refinancing of an existing loan by its wholly-owned subsidiary Emperador International Ltd. (“EIL”) through a facility from a group of Lenders, with Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria, S.A. (“BBVA”), Singapore Branch, Bank of China (Hong Kong) Limited (“BOC”) and DBS Bank Ltd. as the mandated lead arrangers, underwriters and bookrunners (the “MLAUBs”), in the principal amount of EUR300,000, 000 (the “New Facility”). BBVA and BOC also act as the Sustainability Coordinators. The New Facility is a sustainability-linked loan (“SLL”) with two key performance indicators: (1) Reduction of EMI’s Scope 1 and 2 GHG Emission Intensity and (2) Increase in Use of Renewable Electricity.

Press Release entitled "Cosco Capital net income hits PHP 4.47 billion in 1Q 2026, up 21.6%"

Manila, Philippines - Cosco Capital, Inc., the listed retail holding firm of Mr. Lucio L. Co, reported a 21.6% growth in its consolidated net income amounting to Php 4.47 billion for the first quarter of 2026 versus Php 3.68 billion a year ago. Strong operating performance from major business segments also lifted consolidated revenues by 11.3% to Php 63.1 billion in 1Q 2026 from Php 56.7 billion in the same period of 2025. The Group continued to benefit from the economic recovery amidst the prevailing macroeconomic challenges by way of sustained and stronger revenue growth across all its business segments which indicates the recovering consumer demand. In 1Q 2026, the group's grocery retailing businesses, Puregold Price Club, Inc. and S&R Membership Shopping Club, contributed 72% of total net income, followed by the Liquor Distribution with 18%, Commercial Real Estate segment with 8%, Energy & Minerals and Specialty Retail with 2%. The grocery retail segment grew consolidated revenues to Php 58.78 billion for the first quarter 2026, up 12.1% growth from Php 52.42 billion in the same period of 2025. For the first quarter of 2026, the enterprise experienced positive same store sales growth (SSSG) of +5.4% from Puregold Stores driven by higher basket size and +12% from S&R Warehouse clubs driven by higher traffic.The grocery retail group’s consolidated net income for the first quarter 2026 jumped by 23.7% year on year to Php 3.26 billion from Php 2.64 billion driven by strong topline growth and complemented by improvement in gross margins. The Liquor Distribution business thru The Keepers Holdings Inc. has recorded consolidated revenue amounting to Php 4.3 billion, a 6.1% growth versus previous year on the back of a 4% growth in volume of cases sold for the period. This was driven principally by Alfonso, the leading imported brandy in the market, which has already surpassed its pre-pandemic levels, premiumizing market and on-premise channel rebound. Net income for the liquor segment saw an increase of 17.6% to PHP 811 million in 1Q 2026 vs Php 690 million same period 2025. The Commercial Real Estate segment posted a 22.1% growth in rental revenue amounting to PHP 612 million in 1Q 2026 as business operations of its tenants portfolio has improved due to increased level of economic activities as well as full resumption of rental rates based on contracts.
